title: Command Blocks - Shading Tweak
description: Fixes centering and rotational glitches with the command block texture
body:
The vanilla command block textures have some weird alignment and shading issues:

![Vanilla command block textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92a89e3e266155bf928772f14c3189bb2890ae72.png)

The background pattern of the blocks does not tile properly when blocks are rotated:

![Background pattern on vanilla command block textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5011d0e231e8e9a2b2409f1fbccc498f4a53b5c2.png)

The baked in shading leads to the appearence of light coming from different directions based on the block rotation:

![Shading on vanilla command block textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/deaa5354270d29f69a0ec164b4c30ca22bf9491f.png)

This resource pack aims to address some of these issues by updating background texture to tile more evenly, and updating block states to use slightly different panel textures based on face orientation. It also removes the shadow/border from one side of the panel on each face, allowing the panel+border to have an even width to help panels appear more aligned:

![Updated command block texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7609a3e8c4a64b664a7201c3ef3bd7f200d768f4.png)

![Updated background pattern](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acfb33b5baa74c7a3b39d0855f5751d656f4f5b0.png)

![Updated light direction](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6380cb323472380ecd3dc1dd22aae9b265aba68e.png)

For another solution that addresses these issues, as well as other issues with panel alignment, check out [this 32x32 resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/centered-command-blocks) or [the slim border variant](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/centered-command-blocks-slim) on Modrinth.
